_doc: Per-network deploy parameters for the StableNaira CCTP-style stack. Each chain deploys: StableNaira (UUPS proxy + impl + factory), ValidatorRegistry (UUPS), MultisigVerifier (non-upgradeable), MessageTransmitter (UUPS), TokenMessenger (UUPS). BSC chains additionally deploy StableNairaPriceOracle. Domain ids are application-defined uint32 identifiers stamped into every cross-chain message; they MUST match across chains and never collide. Timelock 0 means 'use the contract floor (1h)'. Initial validators / threshold are passed at init and bypass the timelock; everything else (route wiring, validator changes after init, verifier swap) goes through the queue/commit gate.
_admin_history: Rotation log (most recent last). All historical addresses are hyphen-obfuscated so audit-trail entries survive bulk replace_all edits to this template; the current operator address appears un-obfuscated in the live config below. 1) Testnet rollout 2026-05-04: admin/owner/validators/reporters seeded with 0x39-e6-7B-92-38-B8-74-f7-42-33-69-24-54-E2-D0-4E-9f-C6-83-63 (testnet deployer). 2) First mainnet rollout 2026-05-05: rotated to mainnet deployer 0xDe-E6-10-DE-Dc-65-2a-a0-A8-EB-9d-70-EB-41-5d-94-00-fC-F3-87. The live mainnet contracts on BSC, Ethereum, and Base were initialized with that 0xDeE6 address as their on-chain owner. 3) Mainnet re-prep 2026-05-05: rotated forward to 0x39-e6-7B-92-38-B8-74-f7-42-33-69-24-54-E2-D0-4E-9f-C6-83-63 in preparation for a fresh mainnet redeploy under that key (never executed). The 0xDeE6 contracts remain immutable on chain until ownership is transferred or a new deployment supersedes them. 4) Operator key rotation 2026-05-19: rotated to 0xde-6E-09-45-6f-79-96-A6-3A-B3-f3-19-36-e4-9C-8E-F6-a0-F4-19. Used to validate the deploy pipeline against Asset Chain Testnet (single chain, single dry-run); those orphaned testnet contracts remain owned by that key. No mainnet contracts were ever initialized under it. 5) Operator key rotation 2026-05-21: rotated to 0x2503Cba0edfEe3F790D14bA141b92B11816EC987 (current operator key in core/.env). All future deploys initialize under this address. 6) Emergency mainnet ownership rotation 2026-05-21 ~11:00Z: on-chain recon revealed entry 4 was incorrect — 0xde-6E-09 had in fact been initialized as the live on-chain owner across BSC, Ethereum, and Base mainnet contracts (not the 0xDe-E6 inferred by entries 2/5). User reported the key compromised. From 0xde-6E-09 to 0x2503: granted DEFAULT_ADMIN on StableNaira on all 3 chains, granted MINTER on BSC StableNaira, revoked MINTER and DEFAULT_ADMIN from 0xde-6E-09; transferred Ownable2Step ownership of ValidatorRegistry / MessageTransmitter / TokenMessenger on all 3 chains and PriceOracle on BSC; rotated BSC PriceOracle reporters [0x39-e6-7B, 0xde-6E-09] -> [0x2503]; queued ValidatorRegistry.queueReplaceValidator(0x4-5-5-3-1-4-f5-6d-1F-59-89-0e-e6-39-81-35-Bb-E1-E2-08-15-c0-0C -> 0x2503) on all 3 chains (1h timelock, commit pending); swept residual gas from 0xde-6E-09 to 0x2503. BSC bundles routed through 48 Club Puissant; ETH bundles through Flashbots Protect; Base via public RPC (sequencer-only, no MEV). Multisig migration remains the next operational priority.
